_comment: monmove.c m_move() hands a pet's dog_move() result to postmov() with can_tunnel = tunnels(), before the hostile-and-near reduction at 1910-1914, so a tame dwarf skips postmov()'s door-opening block and dig.c mdig_tunnel() breaks the closed door instead ("You feel an unexpected draft."). The port's pet path gave its destination check no can_tunnel and refused the move. Same setup as hostile-dwarf-opens-door, with the dwarf created tame.
